content: {"like":["Intense and high‑stakes storytelling throughout the final seasons","Strong writing and unexpected surprises in seasons six and seven","The storyline extension in the extended versions added useful context","Extended episodes in season eight provided additional character motivation","Season seven was highlighted as one of the best seasons ever","The show’s ability to keep the audience engaged with betrayals and twists"],"dislike":["Limited special features and few deleted scenes in seasons seven, eight, and nine","Scarcity of behind‑the‑scenes material and interviews in the later seasons","The lack of additional content in the extended episodes was disappointing","The reviewer expressed frustration with the portrayal of women being arrested and led away"]}
